lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; same objection as the earlier rulings (boxes G and J). f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 8, code B. The helper is true only for boxes A and D because boxes G to L are refused at the transaction: sales.one refuses when sales.digital ("Digital asset box G–L"), and the refusal reaches every Schedule D total and Form 1040 line 7a (fixture sales.refuse.digital.G). Within boxes A to F the condition reads as the instructions do. The R3 restructuring of the sales questions changed the glossary text, not this line. Project stands on the English.

Ruling: scope; same objection as the earlier rulings (boxes G and J), plus other codes. i8949 p. 8, code B, 'Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)'. Boxes G to L are refused at the transaction: sales.one refuses when sales.digital ('Form 8949 digital asset boxes G–L'), and the refusal reaches every Schedule D total and Form 1040 line 7a; codes other than B and W (E, D, L, O and the rest) are refused by sales.bad_code at sales.one ('Only applicable B and W adjustments are supported'), so the $0 the reviewer sees on those rows is never a computed column (g). The sum of the code B correction and the code W loss is the net adjustment the reviewer accepts. Project stands on the English.
